text:
Maya Singh: Quick follow-up from the active/active RFC: proposing a 'local-first quota + spill-budget' model that uses short-lived lease tokens to avoid hard cross-region failovers.
Tom Alvarez: Can you sketch the lease token idea?
Maya Singh: Each region grants short leases for KV ownership and a separate spill_budget counter. When local capacity exhausted, routers consult tenant consent and spill_budget to decide routing. If spill happens, we request a lease token transfer instead of a blind preempt.
Priya N.: So spill_budget is per-tenant or per-region?
Maya Singh: Per-tenant global budget + per-region local reserve. Tenants opt into global_spill in their residency flag. Global budget helps avoid noisy neighbors using unlimited spill.
Tom Alvarez: Token transfer details? We need an idempotent handshake:
- Preemptor calls POST /handoff/request {lease_id, target_region}
- Owner responds with HandoffAccepted + safe_marker or HandoffDenied
- If accepted, owner issues transfer_token and estimated_kv_warmup_ms
- Preemptor uses transfer_token to request state snapshot or warm the cache before serving
Priya N.: We must forbid forced preemptions for kv_owner unless transfer_token returned. Otherwise p99 explodes.
infra-bot: Canary: lease-spill-prototype deployed to us-east-1 and ap-south-1 (5%). Logs show handoff.req=12 handoff.accept=9 handoff.timeout=3
Tom Alvarez: Nice. How do we account for in-flight requests and cold starts? We should tag requests with `X-Resumption-Point` and `X-Estimated-Warmup-ms` so the client/proxy can set expected timeouts.
Maya Singh: Good call. We'll add `X-Tenant-Consent: region_only|allow_spill` and `X-Resumption-Point: {marker}`. Also add `spill_preempt_budget` per region to cap how many concurrent spill targets are allowed.
Priya N.: Telemetry: handoff.attempts, handoff.success_rate, spill.budget_used_pct, spill.tail_latency_penalty_ms. Alerts if handoff.success_rate < 80% over 5m.
Tom Alvarez: We also need a graceful backoff if handoff times out: attempt local queueing for short time (200-500ms) before deciding to route to shared pool. This avoids constant churn when transient bursts happen.
Maya Singh: Config snippet idea:
```
routing:
  local_reserve: 0.85 # keep 85% for resident guaranteed
  spill_budget_global_per_tenant: 100/min
  spill_preempt_budget_per_region: 5
  handoff_timeout_ms: 3000
```
Priya N.: Safety gate: never use spill for tenants with region_only consent. Also make spill_budget adjustable as a runtime feature flag for incidents.
infra-bot: Metric rule: if handoff.timeout_rate > 10% and spill.tail_latency_penalty_ms > 2000 => page eng-sre.
Tom Alvarez: Action items: I'll prototype the /handoff endpoints and token lifecycle. Priya, can you integrate the headers into the proxy and enforce region_only? Maya, can you draft perf tests that simulate multi-region hot streaks and measure p95/p99 and preemption counts?
Maya Singh: Yep. I'll schedule a 30min lab run with mixed consent tenants and synthetic hotspots across 3 regions. Follow-up sync in 48h.
Priya N.: Also adding dashboard panels for spill.budget_used_pct and handoff.success_rate.
Maya Singh: If this reduces hard failovers we keep tenant SLAs intact while still giving flexible capacity to consenting tenants. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
